CREATE TABLE `membership_plans` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `organization_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `plan_code` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `package_type` enum('individual','couple') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'individual',
  `tier` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `duration_value` smallint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `duration_unit` enum('day','week','month','year') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `currency_code` char(3) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'LKR',
  `included_members` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `paying_members` smallint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `status` enum('active','inactive') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active',
  `created_by_user_id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL,
  `updated_by_user_id` bigint unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_membership_plans_org_code` (`organization_id`,`plan_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_membership_plans_org_id` (`organization_id`,`id`),
  KEY `idx_membership_plans_org_status` (`organization_id`,`status`),
  KEY `idx_membership_plans_org_created` (`organization_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `fk_membership_plans_created_by` (`organization_id`,`created_by_user_id`),
  KEY `fk_membership_plans_updated_by` (`organization_id`,`updated_by_user_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_membership_plans_created_by` FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`, `created_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`organization_id`, `id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_membership_plans_organization` FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`) REFERENCES `organizations` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_membership_plans_updated_by` FOREIGN KEY (`organization_id`, `updated_by_user_id`) REFERENCES `users` (`organization_id`, `id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_membership_plans_couple` CHECK (((`package_type` <> _utf8mb4'couple') or ((`included_members` = 2) and (`paying_members` = 1)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_membership_plans_duration` CHECK ((`duration_value` >= 1)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_membership_plans_individual` CHECK (((`package_type` <> _utf8mb4'individual') or ((`included_members` = 1) and (`paying_members` = 1)))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_membership_plans_member_counts` CHECK (((`included_members` >= `paying_members`) and (`paying_members` >= 1))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_membership_plans_price` CHECK ((`price` >= 0))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=2 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
